claims.claim_text: The indexed Technician Fifth Grade Kenneth R. Bailey is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact name and exact unique private-identifier agreement across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army table documents entry from civil life in June 1943; the OSS index supplies no service date, so the Army-to-OSS sequence requires the personnel file.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is not quoted or exposed. Unrelated common-name candidates were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in June 1943, Kenneth R. Bailey's record carried the civilian occupation category students.

claims.match_notes: This is a status or occupation-only finding. No school is named, and no educational institution is inferred as an employer or affiliation.
